title: Temporary Skill Shortage and Skills in Demand visa (subclass 482) - exemptions

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
Certain TSS and SID visa holders are exempt from the requirement to be employed to work in their nominating employer’s business or associated entity of the Australian nominating business.

To be exempt, your occupation must be on the below list.
